research.title: Nova AI — research brief
research.body:
Nova AI

Overview
Autonomous AI agents for enterprise workflow automation

Market
Nova AI operates in AI/ML, addressing a $47B TAM with a $8B serviceable market and a realistic $400M serviceable obtainable market. The Series A entry point in USA is attractive: autonomous ai agents for enterprise workflow automation. Demand is validated by $2.4M ARR in revenue growing +340% YoY, indicating the market is pulling the product rather than the team pushing it. Competitive window: incumbents in AI/ML are generally 18–30 months behind on AI-native architecture, but that window closes if hyperscalers productise the same capability.

Technology
Technical diligence on Nova AI centres on Marcus Webb (Ex-OpenAI, built GPT-4 fine-tuning infra). 48-person team at Series A is an appropriate engineering-to-GTM ratio. The core differentiator — Proprietary fine-tuning pipeline creates durable moat — is defensible if it survives independent benchmarking. Open items: architecture scalability under 10x load, cloud/vendor dependency, on-prem or data-residency support (required by a majority of enterprise buyers in AI/ML), and whether the moat is data, distribution, or engineering speed. Technical debt appears manageable at this headcount.

Financials
At $80M on $2.4M ARR, the round prices at 33.3x ARR. Growth of +340% YoY is the headline metric and is above the Series A median for AI/ML. Key unknowns that drive the model: average contract value, gross margin after inference/compute costs, CAC payback period, net revenue retention, and burn multiple. A 33.3x multiple leaves little margin of safety — we would need retention above 115% and gross margin above 70% to justify it. Runway post-raise must be modelled at 18 months minimum before we commit.

Risks to verify
• Crowded market — 200+ competitors in AI automation

Next questions
• What is net revenue retention over the last four quarters, and how much of $2.4M ARR is expansion vs new logos?
• Break down gross margin after compute/inference costs — and how does it move at 5x volume?
• Who are the top 5 customers as a percentage of ARR, and what triggered any churn in the last 12 months?
• What specifically is defensible about founding team from deepmind + openai, 3 prior exits — and how long until a well-funded competitor replicates it?
• Post-raise runway in months at current burn, and what milestone does this round have to hit before the next one?
• How is equity split among Sarah Chen and Marcus Webb, and what are the vesting terms?
